entities.summary: Travis Ford is an American college basketball coach. He is the head coach at Little Rock. He previously was the Head Coach at Saint Louis University, Oklahoma State, Massachusetts, Eastern Kentucky and Campbellsville University. Prior to that, he played at the University of Missouri and the University of Kentucky.
